title.en: Capstone 02 — RAG over Codebase (Cross-Repo Semantic Search)

hook: Every serious engineering org in 2026 runs an internal code search that understands meaning, not just strings. Sourcegraph Amp, Cursor's codebase answers, Augment's enterprise graph, Aider's repomap, Pinterest's internal MCP — same shape. Ingest many repos, parse with tree-sitter, embed function- and class-level chunks, hybrid-search, re-rank, answer with citations. This capstone asks you to build one that handles 2M lines of code across 10 repos and survives incremental re-indexing on every git push.
